owner: Meme Alpha Lab using existing Microcap Research Agent and prospective hardening owners

motivation.forbidden_use: FUSE outcome may not set weights, thresholds, winner labels, or count as prospective evidence
motivation.research_question: Can a cheap deterministic discovery funnel find unusually promising stealth-launched Ethereum microcaps early enough to justify bounded deep research before broad propagation, while maintaining acceptable false-positive rate and cost?

reuse_existing_owners.principle: DISCOVERY_FUNNEL_ONLY; do not create a parallel token-research, regime, portfolio, or trading engine

scope.denominator: all observed eligible Ethereum launch events after deterministic deduplication

stage_0_broad_deterministic_intake.goal: observe thousands of raw events cheaply and preserve a denominator
required_event_classes: EVM CREATE and CREATE2 contract creation candidates
ERC-20 transfer/interface fingerprints when deterministically identifiable
Uniswap v4 PoolManager Initialize events and pool identifiers
known launchpad/factory deployment or pool-initialization events
DEX new-pair/profile feeds as secondary discovery, never sole truth
exact-CA mentions from a frozen approved social discovery source universe
stage_0_broad_deterministic_intake.uniswap_v4_rule: Do not assume one newly tradable pool equals one newly deployed pair contract; observe PoolManager initialization semantics explicitly.

hard_fail: no verified tradable route after observation window
sell path fails or explicit honeypot behavior is observed
executable liquidity is effectively absent for all preregistered test notionals
required_components: top-holder and deployer concentration excluding known pool/burn infrastructure where reproducible
bundle/sniper concentration where provider methodology is available

product_and_execution: live product before broad token propagation
on-chain product usage independent of governance-token trading
social_propagation: number of exact-CA mentions from distinct control roots
historical caller-quality ledger available before the current launch
time from CA/pool creation to first credible mention
time from first credible mention to broad propagation
stage_1_feature_vector_no_magic_score.rule: Do not collapse these components into one attractiveness score in v1.

prospective_comparison_arms.CONTROL: Safety/executability-passing matched launches sampled without feature trigger.
prospective_comparison_arms.MS: Microstructure plus frozen-source exact-CA social propagation.
prospective_comparison_arms.MSP: Microstructure plus social plus authenticated product/execution convergence.
prospective_comparison_arms.purpose: Estimate incremental value of social and product evidence rather than crediting the full FUSE-like bundle post hoc.

control_matching_dimensions: same broad market day or regime when feasible
matching_and_sampling.deep_dive_selection: Within each active arm, preserve every triggered candidate in the ledger. If more than the daily deep-dive cap trigger, choose by a frozen deterministic tie-break that does not use future price performance.

stage_2_bounded_deep_research.activation: Only candidates admitted by preregistered arm logic receive model/web research.
mandatory_questions: Is the product actually live and causally linked to the exact CA?
Was product usage measurable before broad propagation?
Is value capture observable on-chain or only marketing copy?
Are team/project claims authenticated and what remains unknown?
Are early social nodes independent control roots and historically informative before this launch?
Can each preregistered test notional enter and exit after realistic slippage?
What evidence would falsify the thesis at 1h, 4h, 24h, 3d, and 7d?

per_window: realizable return after estimated slippage for each test notional
outcome_contract.missed_winner_audit: Required for the entire Stage-0 universe, not only researched candidates.

promotion_and_kill.minimum_observation_requirement: At least 30 calendar days and enough triggered/control observations for interpretable arm comparison; do not promote on a few memorable hits.
promotion_requires: At least one triggered arm improves actionable precision versus matched control without unacceptable recall collapse.
Signal remains after excluding paid-profile status as a positive feature.
No single caller, launchpad, or one-off winner explains the majority of measured edge.
API/model cost remains compatible with Meme Alpha budget policy.
kill_or_redraft_if: Triggered arms do not beat matched controls.
Social edge exists only when caller universe is selected with hindsight.
Product evidence becomes observable only after broad token appreciation and therefore has no discovery lead time.
The funnel requires model/web deep dives on a large fraction of raw contracts and fails the cost objective.
Uniswap v4 or factory identity cannot be resolved reliably enough to preserve a valid denominator.

fuse_replay_role.expected_without_hindsight: A reconstruction around the documented approximately 12-hour launch window should test whether FUSE would have been escalated to deep research, not whether it should have been automatically bought.
